title: Path of Exile 2 0.5.4b — Boss Readability, Expedition and Atlas Fixes
summary: 0.5.4b reorganised by player problem: which Boss fights got readability passes, which Expedition completion bugs were fixed, and how that changes our Boss and Guide pages.
description: 0.5.4b is not a content patch. It is a Boss-readability and Expedition-completion fix wave that must be recorded separately from 0.5.4 and the later Hotfixes.
author: Exile2 Guides Editorial Team
imageAlt: A storm-darkened ruined city representing the 0.5.4b Boss and Expedition fixes

versions.summary: Runes of Aldur and the systems that 0.5.4b later adjusted.
Boss readability pass and Expedition completion fixes described on this page.
Oath Rune invincible-monster fix that Expedition pages must also cite.

cards.detail: Arbiter and Vessel of Kulemak got clearer windows and earlier cues. Old timing descriptions are stale.
Invisible, invincible, out-of-bounds and underground issues were addressed. Route Guides must re-verify.
The invincible-monster case was fixed after 0.5.4b, so 0.5.4b alone is not enough.
0.5.4b did not grant new Atlas points; it fixed progression-blocking states.

sections.title: Official changes, reorganised by player problem

changes.title: Arbiter of Ash / Divinity readability
changes.detail: Longer reaction windows and earlier voice/visual cues on key abilities. Guide attack tables need a window re-check.

changes.title: Vessel of Kulemak cues
changes.detail: Burning Ground and final-phase summon cues clarified; portal visuals and attack windows adjusted.

changes.title: Expedition invisible / invincible monsters
changes.detail: Monsters that could not be targeted or damaged in some Expedition states were fixed.

changes.title: Expedition out-of-bounds and underground
changes.detail: Players and monsters leaving the playable area, and underground rendering, were corrected.

changes.title: Atlas progression blockers
changes.detail: Several states that blocked Atlas or map completion were resolved.

sections.title: Boss changes that affect our pages

bosses.name: Arbiter of Ash
bosses.detail: Flame Seed reaction time extended and voice cue added in 0.5.4b on top of 0.5.4 Sphere buffs.
bosses.action: Re-cut video timestamps and attack table

bosses.name: Arbiter of Divinity
bosses.detail: Orb of Divinity visual timing improved; later fixes addressed loot position and exit cues.

bosses.name: Vessel of Kulemak
bosses.detail: Burning Ground and final-phase summon cues clarified; portal visuals and attack windows adjusted.

sections.title: Expedition completion fixes
sections.oldText: Route Guides written before 0.5.4b may promise exits or completions that failed because of invisible or out-of-bounds states.
sections.newText: State that 0.5.4b fixed these states; for Oath Rune, also cite the later Hotfix before claiming a route is safe.

reports.quote: The Arbiter windows finally feel fair after the cue change.
reports.analysis: Matches the official readability goal; keep it as a community signal, not a mechanical proof.

reports.quote: Underground mobs still felt inconsistent until the follow-up fix.
reports.analysis: Confirms why Expedition pages must cite the later Hotfix, not 0.5.4b alone.
